audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Ziggs Levels 3, 6 and 2+ items and read Skill at 4-5 and first item; the mirror settled the lane the other way through the middle.
audit.why: The mirror (illaoi__ziggs) fixed it as Ziggs at levels 1-2, Illaoi from level 3 through first item, and Skill at 2+ items. The middle rows are hers because Tentacle Smash matches your bomb's 850 range while her tentacles heal her through your chip.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 through 6 flipped on both layers as one atomic group with ratings rebuilt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike; no cooldown or range appeared anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range, Tentacle Smash 10s down to 6s at 850, Harsh Lesson a flat 4s at 400, Leap of Faith 120/95/70s at 450. Your Bouncing Bomb is 850 — identical to her Q — Satchel Charge 20s at rank 1 and 1000 range, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s at 900 with reduced damage on repeat detonations.
audit.corrected: Real timers written into early, mid and the phase whys, with the step-up rule keyed to Test of Spirit's 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors: Illaoi called immobile with no gap-closer in four fields, Test of Spirit described as a pull, and Leap of Faith described as a wall or flood of tentacles.
audit.why: Harsh Lesson leaps her to her target on a flat 4s cooldown and resets her attack — she absolutely has a gap-closer, and it is the fastest button in her kit. Test of Spirit rips your spirit out and stands it in front of her; the spirit echoes a share of the damage it takes onto you, and if it dies or you walk too far you become a Vessel. Nothing about it pulls you. Leap of Faith spawns one tentacle per champion hit, which in a solo lane is exactly one. And her passive heals her whenever a tentacle damages a champion, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: The gap-closer stated with its 4s cooldown and auto-reset tell, the spirit mechanic described correctly, the tentacle 'wall' removed, and anti-heal added.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Illaoi can't read the angle.
edits.after: Tentacle Smash is 850 — the same reach as your bomb — and every tentacle hit on you heals her through the chip.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Leap of Faith is 450 range on 120s at rank 1, and spawns one tentacle per champion hit — in a solo lane, one.

edits.before: Illaoi is immobile so your Level 1 poke is completely free.
edits.after: Level 1 poke is free before Harsh Lesson has a target.

edits.before: Level 3 you dodge her E and punish her with uncontested poke.
edits.after: Level 3: Tentacle Smash matches your 850 and heals her.

edits.before: Through Levels 4 you out-range her and deny CS at no risk.
edits.after: Levels 4-5: a landed Test of Spirit echoes damage onto you.

edits.before: At Level 6 her R tentacle field and E pull can delete you if caught.
edits.after: At 6 Leap of Faith adds another tentacle and the slams finish you.

edits.before: With two items you out-range her immobile frame from the back line.
edits.after: Two items in you siege from 850, but Harsh Lesson still leaps 400.

edits.before: Her R Leap of Faith spawns a wall of tentacles and if she lands E on you the pull plus tentacle slams delete you; W Satchel yourself out the moment she R's and never fight inside her tentacle field.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (R) spawns one tentacle per champion hit — in a solo lane that is one, not a wall. The danger is Test of Spirit (E): it rips your spirit out and echoes its damage onto you, so kill the spirit fast.

edits.before: Late you out-range her hard: she has no gap-closer, so from the back line your R Mega Inferno Bomb and Bouncing Bomb poke her down before she can ever reach you or plant tentacles on you.
edits.after: Late you hold the range: Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000 and your bomb 850 against her 850, so siege from the back. Harsh Lesson still leaps 400 onto a target, so never be the closest body to her.

edits.before: Levels 1-4 are yours: Illaoi is immobile with no gap-closer, so as long as you dodge her E Test of Spirit skillshot you free-poke with Short Fuse autos and Bouncing Bomb and shove her off CS with zero risk.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours, but she is not immobile: Harsh Lesson (W) leaps 400 onto a target every 4s and resets her auto, so the wind-up is your cue to step back. Dodge Test of Spirit (E) and free-poke while it is on its 16s.

edits.before: Levels 5-6 flip to Illaoi: her R Leap of Faith floods the lane with tentacles and a single landed E pulls you into slams that delete you, and her first item makes those slams hit like a truck, so hold W Satchel and never fight in her field.
edits.after: Levels 3 through first item belong to Illaoi: Tentacle Smash (Q) is 850, the same as your bomb, and every tentacle that hits you heals her — buy Grievous Wounds. Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1; step up only on its downtime.

edits.after: Grievous Wounds before her tentacles heal

edits.before: Land E Test of Spirit to pull you into tentacle slams

notes: This is the fourth Illaoi page the run has found claiming Leap of Faith produces a tentacle wall or field; Riot's text is one tentacle per champion hit. The 'Illaoi is immobile / has no gap-closer' claim appeared in four fields on this page and is flatly wrong — Harsh Lesson is a 400-range leap on a flat 4s. breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t say 'Favoured matchup' while diff reads EVEN; left alone since the chart change may move that rating, and flagged here instead. Not asserted: whether Satchel Charge's knockback can push you far enough from your spirit to trigger the Vessel condition, and whether the derived 'grounding' flag on Leap of Faith is real — Riot's description says nothing about it, so I treated it as a tooltip-parsing misfire.
